name: Large DC motors
summary: Big permanent-magnet DC motors, often 90–180V and 1–3 hp: the best scrap generators.
uses: Wind or water generators (treadmill motors are famous for this)
Driving a grinder, lathe or saw from DC
Golf cart and small electric vehicle drives
identify: Heavy cylinders with two thick wires and a flywheel or pulley: under the hood of treadmills, in golf carts, forklifts, floor scrubbers and some industrial machines. The label gives volts, amps and rpm.
test: Spin the shaft and measure DC volts across the two wires: it should rise with speed. Short the wires and the shaft should get much harder to turn.

decay.note: Lasts. Brushes wear but can be replaced.
